The bundled GLB is unchanged. Runtime adaptations by this project: uniform
scaling and centering, source-axis correction, four wheel-center pivots and
steering/rolling animation, gold metallic paint with moderate golden emission
and a procedural reflection environment, capped lamp emission, and back-face
solid shadow casting. Glass, tires, trim, rims and light colors are retained.
